content: {"episode_id":"ep-05035","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05035. The clinical indication states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies. On this documented indication, the service was medically necessary, and we request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 555.69."}
